verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a candidate profile record. Candidates are created with a CV, custom profile fields can be added to a candidate, and email is described as handled "all in one place." The evidence never shows these elements brought together in one unified record. missing for 10: interview feedback on the profile, consent/GDPR status on the record, a per-candidate activity timeline (audit logs only track admin data changes), explicit evidence that email threads attach to the candidate profile, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record

citations.quote: the header in their candidate profile will say that they were manually added
